Offer 4 PoE ports with a maximum output power of 90W per port, enabling simultaneous transmission of both power and data signals to end devices over a single Cat.5e or higher Ethernet cable, eliminating the need for separate power cables and simplifying installation and maintenance.

This Gigabit Industrial Switch features two 2.5G Base-X SFP ports and offers an increased switching capacity for non-blocking high-speed data forwarding. It supports high-bandwidth connections and is compatible with auto-adaptive fiber optic modules for 155M, 1G, 1.25G, and 2.5G, providing a broader range of data rates.

The device features IP40 protection and a rugged high-strength metal case, designed for reliable operation in demanding industrial environments. It supports DIN35 rail mounting and boasts an EMC grade 4 design, ensuring resilience against electromagnetic interference. With a working temperature range of -40℃ to 75℃, it is built to withstand harsh conditions while delivering optimal performance.
• Dual Power Input Design
The device features dual power input, enabling you to set up multiple power sources for enhanced reliability and redundancy. This design guarantees that your system stays operational during power failures or unexpected shutdowns.
• Rich Management Function
Support port management, ACL, QoS, VLANS, RSTP, STP, VLAN, LACP, LLDP, Multicast and more.
• ERPS Ring

robust self-recovery capability that operates within 12ms.
This feature helps prevent interruptions and external threats, significantly improving system reliability and uptime across diverse environments.
• Integrated PoE Features for Managing PD
Designed as a managed PoE switch for surveillance, wireless, and VoIP networks, the HR600-BTGM-42AS offers several advanced PoE management features, including:
• PoE Watchdog
• PoE Configuration
• PoE Schedule
• PoE Timer Management
PoE Watchdog
Detect and reboot dropped or unresponsive PoE-powered devices.
PoE Configuration
Provide configuration support for PoE settings, including parameters such as
temperature, type, level, power, current, total PoE power budget management, PoE power control, port priority allocations, and individualized power limits for each PoE port.
This thorough strategy will optimize PoE management, promote efficient resource utilization, and improve device reliability and performance.
PoE Schedule
Support for customizing the schedule to turn the PoE function on or off based on specific needs. This flexibility not only helps optimize energy consumption but also reduces operational costs, making it an efficient solution for energy management.
PoE Timer Management
Support rebooting the PoE function of port during a specified time. This will help reduce device crashes caused by buffer overflow, ensuring more reliable and stable performance during designated time intervals.

The HR600-BTGM-42AS supports both IPv6 and IPv4 protocols, enabling SMBs to transition to the IPv6 era with minimal investment. There's no need to replace or overhaul existing network infrastructure when implementing the IPv6 networking.

The HR600-BTGM-42AS features advanced cybersecurity measures, including SSHv2 and SNMPv3 protocols, to protect against cyber threats. Its robust security capabilities enhance switch management while maintaining cost-effective deployment for critical network operations.

Support for Fiber Module DDM (Digital Diagnostic Monitoring) includes tracking key parameters such as transceiver supply voltage, temperature, transmitter bias current, transmitter output power, and received optical power. By analyzing these metrics, you can effectively diagnose issues that may be affecting the transceiver optics' performance.
• IEEE 1588 Solution
The HR600-BTGM-42AS is perfectly suited for telecommunications and Carrier Ethernet applications, compatible with IEEE 1588 and synchronous Ethernet.

With 24 2.5G RJ45 ports and 2 10G SFP+ ports, this switch provides unmatched flexibility and scalability to meet the demands of your growing network. Whether you are deploying a small business network or enhancing your existing infrastructure, this switch is equipped to handle high-speed data transfer while ensuring power delivery to connected devices.
Product Features:
Versatile Port:
24 x 2.5G RJ45 ports for flexible connectivity.
2 x 10G SFP+ ports for high-speed uplinks or fiber connections.
Comprehensive Standards Support:
Compatible with IEEE802.3, IEEE802.3u, IEEE802.3x, IEEE802.3ab, and IEEE802.3z for reliable performance and interoperability.
Adaptive Speed Functionality:
RJ45 ports automatically adapt to 100M, 1G, and 2.5G speeds, optimizing your network environment.
Automatic MDI/MDIX:
Simplifies installation and connectivity with automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX), eliminating the need for crossover cables.
Efficient Data Processing:
Utilizes a store-and-forward switching mechanism to reduce packet loss and enhance overall performance.
Non-blocking Architecture:
All ports support line-speed switching, ensuring seamless data flow without bottlenecks.
Real-time Monitoring:
Panel indicator LEDs provide immediate feedback on port status and assist in quick fault diagnosis.
Quality of Service (QoS):
Prioritizes traffic to ensure optimal performance for critical applications and services.
Web Management Interface:
Intuitive web-based management allows for easy configuration, monitoring, and administration from any device.
Power over Ethernet (PoE):
Ports 1-4 support a total power budget of 90W, enabling seamless power delivery to compatible devices like IP cameras and access points.
HRUI Smart Web Management 24-Port 2.5G PoE Switch is designed to provide 2.5Gbps RJ-45 ports and 10Gbps SFP+ ports to create lightning-fast and reliable connections. With this switch, you can effortlessly bridge the gap between WiFi 6 access points, storage servers, and other devices to receive both data and power over a single Ethernet cable simultaneously.
The product is easy to use, plug-and-play with no configuration needed, making it ideal for high-speed network scenarios.

Delivers rapid 2.5G network transfer speeds, enabling connections for numerous devices, including WiFi 6 access points and 8K PoE cameras. Perfect for applications demanding ultra-high-speed data transfers in today’s fast-moving environment.
Provide highly reliable and stable transmission to meet high traffic demands such as high-definition video transmission and large data processing.
Allow for future growth and expansion, reducing the need for costly infrastructure upgrades down the line.
A 2.5G network offers cost benefits over a 10Gb network, offering speed gains while using existing Cat.5e cables, and reducing deployment costs by avoiding costly new wiring infrastructure.
• PoE Technology
The product offers 24 PoE ports compliant with IEEE 802.3af/at/bt standards, with ports 1-4 providing 90W PoE output and the remaining ports providing 30W. It can deliver both power and data to terminal devices over a single cable, eliminating the need for additional power lines.
• 2.5G Ports
Featuring 2.5GBASE-T RJ-45 ports, which enable faster gigabit speeds of up to 2.5Gbps over standard Cat5e or higher cabling infrastructure. Perfect for connecting high-bandwidth devices, such as WiFi 6 routers, APs, NAS units, and gaming equipment, ensuring seamless and efficient data transfer.
• WEB-based Management
The product offers advanced software features, including VLAN, port mirroring, flow control, LACP, QoS, and DHCP Snooping, to cater to diverse network demands and enhance network security, reliability, and scalability.
• Isolated Dual Outputs Power Supply
Adopting isolated dual outputs power supply design (DC 54V/9.5A & 12V/4A), the motherboard and PoE power supply module are powered separately and independently, eliminating interference and ensuring stability and safety. Ensure the PoE power output of the whole machine is maximized and can power up to multiple PoE+ IP devices simultaneously.
• Jumbo Frames (up to 10KB)
Jumbo Frames can reduce bandwidth usage by carrying more data in each Ethernet frame, resulting in fewer transactions on the network. This reduction in traffic also reduces stress on networking equipment.
• Plug and Play
• Rock-solid Reliability
No configuration is required. Simply plug a device into the network. It automation begins.
Support 4KV surge protection against harsh environments.

By integrating power delivery into a single cable, these switches streamline cabling infrastructure and eliminate the need for separate power sources, thereby providing an efficient and cost-effective solution for powering network devices.

VLAN:
Downlink ports are isolated from each other, but can still communicate with uplink ports. This mode also enables PoE watchdog on ports.
Default:

overview:
The HRUI AI PoE switches provide a range of models featuring both 100M/Gigabit PoE, RJ45, and SFP uplink ports. These switches meet the IEEE 802.3af/at/Hi-PoE standards for Power over Ethernet, with PoE port 1 capable of delivering a maximum output of 60W and other PoE ports capable of 30W. The devices offer three working modes: Default, VLAN (Port Isolation), and Extend. Additionally, the series supports PoE watchdog functionality in both VLAN and Extend modes, enabling the detection and automatic reboot of unresponsive or dropped PoE-powered devices.
With user-friendly installation and maintenance processes, these switches help establish a secure and high-performance network. HRUI AI PoE switches are ideal for various Ethernet access applications, including small to medium-sized enterprises, internet cafes, hotels, and schools.
FEATURES
• Power Over Ethernet
This series of switches provides PoE ports, compliant with IEEE 802.3af/at/high PoE, enabling simultaneous data and power transmission to devices via a single, convenient Ethernet cable. Specifically,
PoE Port 1 offers a maximum output power of 60 watts
, permitting the powering of high-power devices. By integrating power delivery into a single cable, these switches streamline cabling infrastructure and eliminate the need for separate power sources, thereby providing an efficient and cost-effective solution for powering network devices.
• Advanced Functions with DIP Switch
VLAN:
Downlink ports are isolated from each other, but can still communicate with uplink ports. This mode also enables PoE watchdog on ports.

The downlink PoE & data transmission distance of 9-24 ports can reach up to 250 meters, with a speed of 10Mbps. This mode enables PoE watchdog on ports.
• AI PoE Watchdog
Detect and reboot dropped or unresponsive PoE-powered devices.
• Safe PoE Smart Boot-up
Support PoE Smart Boot-up that enables PoE on ports from the first to last in sequence to prevent damage to the power supply by sudden large currents. The function is enabled by default.
• A Clear View of Power Usage
The product feature PoE Max indicators, allowing for easy monitoring of power consumption, enabling optimal power usage and ensuring efficient energy management.
• Plug and Play, Easy to Use
All Ethernet ports on our switches support MDI/MDIX compatibility, allowing for easy setup with no software installation or configuration needed.
• 19 Inch Rack Mout
• High Reliable Design
Support installed in a standard rack environment, easy to integrate with other equipment and manage cabling.
Support 4KV surge and 8KV ESD protection.

The HRUI AI PoE switches provide a range of models featuring both 100M/Gigabit PoE, RJ45, and SFP uplink ports. These switches meet the IEEE 802.3af/at/Hi-PoE standards for Power over Ethernet, with PoE port 1 capable of delivering a maximum output of 60W and other PoE ports capable of 30W. The devices offer three working modes: Default, VLAN (Port Isolation), and Extend. Additionally, the series supports PoE watchdog functionality in both VLAN and Extend modes, enabling the detection and automatic reboot of unresponsive or dropped PoE-powered devices.
